svg.title: A voltage source with internal resistance and a load
svg.desc: A source of emf with internal resistance r on the left drives current I clockwise through a load resistance R_load on the right. I = emf/(R_load + r). An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: A real battery under a changing load
I = ε/(R + r) and V terminal = ε − Ir. As load resistance rises, current and internal voltage loss
fall; terminal voltage approaches the emf.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
